subject: Computação
description_pt: Compreender e utilizar diferentes formas de armazenar, manipular, compactar e recuperar arquivos, documentos e metadados. Entender como os dados são armazenados, processados e transmitidos usando dispositivos computacionais, considerando aspectos da segurança cibernética.

components.description_pt: Explicar como dados são armazenados e recuperados usando dispositivos computacionais
components.description_en: Explain how data are stored and retrieved using computing devices
components.cc_component_description: Describe how digitized information is stored in computer memory as binary data arrays

components.description_pt: Descrever métodos para compactar e manipular arquivos e documentos digitais
components.description_en: Describe methods for compressing and manipulating digital files and documents
components.cc_component_description: Describe how digital devices encode and decode information between digital and analog forms

components.description_pt: Identificar o que são metadados e explicar seu papel na organização de arquivos digitais
components.description_en: Identify what metadata is and explain its role in organizing digital files

components.description_pt: Explicar como dados são transmitidos entre dispositivos computacionais
components.description_en: Explain how data are transmitted between computing devices
components.cc_component_description: Explain how communication devices encode and transmit information across distances

components.description_pt: Descrever considerações de segurança cibernética envolvidas no armazenamento e transmissão de dados
components.description_en: Describe cybersecurity considerations involved in storing and transmitting data

cc_matches.description: Digitized information can be transmitted over long distances without significant degradation. High-tech devices, such as computers or cell phones, can receive and decode information—convert it from digitized form to voice—and vice versa.
People also use a variety of devices to communicate (send and receive information) over long distances.

Information can be digitized (e.g., a picture stored as the values of an array of pixels); in this form, it can be stored reliably in computer memory and sent over long distances as a series of wave pulses.
